name: Gasthof zum Löwen
beschreibung:
Located in the charming mountain village of Fliess, the historic Gasthof zum Loewen welcomes holidaymakers with cosy rooms and hearty regional dishes. It is an ideal hub for cultural discoveries and nature trips.

The Kaunergrat Nature Park Centre, the Venet and Serfaus-Fiss-Ladis ski areas, and alpine trails are quickly reached.
kurzbeschreibung: The historic Gasthof zum Loewen in Fliess provides traditional inn hospitality in the Kaunergrat Nature Park.
